name: Schoolgirl x Squid
source:
Schoolgirl x Squid is a heart-warming tale, in which you - Kitashikawa Moe, a Japanese schoolgirl and part-time fashion blogger - must take care of a cute pet squid. Try not to kill him - because, in all honesty, he’s one of the only friends you have… Or, maybe even more……

For all the people who have ever wanted to date a squid, this is definitely the visual novel for you!

[From [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/57874063851/schoolgirl-x-squid-download]official site[/url]]
translation:
《女学生x乌贼》是一个温馨的故事，在这个故事中，你——日本女学生兼兼职时尚博主北石川萌——必须照顾一只可爱的宠物乌贼。尽量不要杀他——因为，老实说，他是你唯一的朋友之一……或者，也许更多……

对于所有想和鱿鱼约会的人来说，这绝对是适合你的视觉小说！

[来自[url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/57874063851/schoolgirl-x-squid-download]官方网站[/url]]
